This is warranty is only valid if you previously bought your laser cap and chose not to buy the warranty at the discounted rate when you purchased your laser cap.  Any warranty bought outside of your 45 day purchase is invalid and will be refunded.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

This purchase extends the standard warranty of your Kiierr Laser Cap from TWO (2) years to FIVE (5) years.

•Your additional warranty is non-transferable. Only the ORIGINAL PURCHASER can add the extended warranty.
•The extended warranty is subject to the same terms as your original warranty except for the fact that it extends coverage to FIVE years total from the original purchase date of your product.
•3-year extended warranty purchased after 45 days of purchase will not be honored.
